principle: Same inputs for every strategy; the direction flips with the trade. Selling options wants the richest options, buying wants the cheapest. Bullish trades (sell put, long call) want strong names; bearish trades (long put, sell call on a weak name) want weak ones. Each cell says what the strategy wants, where it is live, and the evidence — untested cells are the study queue.
how_to_change: Edit this file (one home, AGENTS rule 5). A cell moves to 'works' only with a study row in research/studies/INDEX.md; a live weight change also needs a before/after (rule 7).

engine._doc: Machine-readable half of this file, read by strategy_engine.py (Structures board; the Model List inherits it via Cursor's unification). Every structure maps to one strategy; each strategy lists hard gates (all must pass), a re-strike rule and its rank inputs (sign-weighted within-day ranks). Edit here, not in code.

rich_put._doc: Second sold-put lane (Jamie 10-26/27, S107 + S109 real quotes): Jamie's rule, ranked by confidence, every passing name shown (no peer cap, no hiding). Shadow-graded per name and per sector (grade_ledger folder rich_puts → scoreboard). Size is Jamie's call — the row shows the gap loss, not a size.
rich_put._min_bid: tick floor only; a $5 strike bidding $0.05 is 1 %/wk. Liquidity = verify_plan's OI ≥ 100 or volume ≥ 25
rich_put._crash: Jamie's third leg (≥ 25 % off the 52-week high) is shown as a tag, not required: S109 rule with it +101 bp/wk, without it +104 (same tail)

near_low._why: S110 (Jamie 10-27: ONDS/RKLB sit near 3-month lows): a 5–10 % OTM put paying ≥ 0.9 %/wk on a stock within 5 % of its 63-day low earned +89 bp/wk (kept 79 %, worst-5 % week −298; halves +51 / +122) vs +44 for the same distance off the low — passes the pre-set bar, but n = 81, so it is its own tier, below the rule's tiers

closer._why: S110 (Jamie 10-27: ONDS 6p / RKLB 51p): any 5–10 % OTM put paying ≥ 0.9 %/wk earned +57 bp/wk (kept 76 %, worst-5 % week −414; halves +42 / +72, 591 puts). A support zone does not separate them — strike under support +43 (−590), strike inside a zone +54 (−486), no zone +52 (−529) — so support is shown, not required. Last tier: visible and ranked, weakest record

flags._why: S110: inside the rule these mark better puts, but blended into the score they did not improve the ranking in both halves (they overlap income + distance) → shown, not scored. As a substitute for the 10 % buffer: support FAIL (−28 bp/wk), analyst target FAIL (not both halves)
flags.pt: rule puts with the street target ≥ 30 % above spot +131 bp/wk (worst-5 % −183) vs +62 (−436) without
flags.support: rule puts with a ≥ 2-method support zone between strike and spot +104 bp/wk (worst-5 % −238) vs +61 (−578) without

rich_put._gap_loss: row shows $ lost per contract if the stock closes 40 % lower at expiry (a bad week for these names) next to the premium

confidence._how: score = mean of the put's income percentile and OTM percentile against S109's real rule puts (2020-12 → 2026-10, 397 puts); both rose monotonically by tercile in both halves; kept % barely moved (81/85/89) — the payoff, not the hit rate, separates them

sell_put._verdict: 10-26 (Jamie OK, S069 / S063): the red risk flag no longer blocks sold puts — flagged names earned more per week (S069 +4.5 vs −3.1 bp, t 2.7; low credit +13.1, t 4.15) with a fatter tail → the far rule (build_plan.put_far_reason: credit < 20 / put-risk note / red flag) moves the strike to 0.06–0.08Δ and the reason says size small

gates._unknown: no put-edge inputs → blocked as "put-edge unknown" (Jamie 10-20 for the Model List; every surface since 10-26)

relax._why: S102 (10-26): inside a sector drop Q1–Q3 earn +51…+89 bp/wk both periods (vs normal-market Q5 +34/+48 at 0.06–0.10Δ); their 0.15–0.20Δ tail is too fat (worst 5 % −166/−237) but 0.10–0.15Δ holds (+62/+52 bp, worst 5 % +21/−60) → allowed, one band nearer than Q4–5

strike._band_engine: A277 §8 / S101 (Jamie 10-26): the band moves with market state (panic / sharp drop / bear grind / normal / rally) × stock state (crashed / normal / extended); band_engine.py picks the best net bp/wk whose worst 5 % week ≥ floor (standard −200, aggressive −400) and only leaves the base band when that beat it in both halves of the fit. Panic → no new puts. default_band = fallback when the table is missing. OOS 2023→: standard +28.2 bp/wk, max DD −4.1 % vs the old fixed 0.08–0.10 +28.1 / −9.8 %.
